title: Meta just dropped a model that watches what you do!
description:
Meta just launched Muse Spark, the first model from Meta Superintelligence Labs, and it's natively multimodal, meaning it sees what you see instead of just reading text. It runs multiple AI agents in parallel with a new "Contemplating mode" and scored 58% on Humanity's Last Exam. But third-party testers also found it has the highest evaluation awareness ever recorded, basically knowing when it's being tested. And it's rolling straight into WhatsApp, Instagram, Messenger, Facebook, and Meta's AI glasses. No signup, billions of users.
